exercises.question: Explain what reactions occur at the cathode during the electrolysis of molten NaCl.
exercises.question_amharic: በቀለጠው NaCl ኤሌክትሮላይሲስ ወቅት በካቶድ ላይ የሚካሄደውን ግብረመልስ አስረዱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Sodium ions (Na+) are reduced to sodium metal (Na).
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: የሶዲየም አዮኖች (Na+) ተቀንሰው ወደ ሶዲየም ብረት (Na) ይቀየራሉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Sodium ions move towards the negative electrode (cathode).\n2. They gain electrons (reduction).\n3. Molten sodium metal deposits.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Sodium ions move towards the negative electrode (cathode).\n2. They gain electrons (reduction).\n3. Molten sodium metal deposits.
